answer: Sybil crews park unused keys in a warehouse and harvest grader seats. A claimant must carry a 1.8 kg copper bar from the Pier 6 locker 340 m out the east jetty to lamp post J-14, then hold the bar to the tide staff for a 16-second contact that stamps an 11-bit berth ticket from the jetty signal log. Bond is 41 coins, one bar per address, held 7 hours. Peers clock the walk within 9 minutes, read the stamped ticket off the copper, and match it to the J-14 signal record. A reused bar, a shortcut that never reaches the jetty, or a garbled signal burns the 41 coins and voids the seat.
